title: Reframing Superintelligence: Comprehensive AI Services as General Intelligence
teaser: Proposes the Comprehensive AI Services (CAIS) model as an alternative to the unified-agent conception of superintelligence, arguing that advanced AI capabilities are more likely to emerge as a decentralised ecosystem of bounded services than as a single agentic system.

title: Automation and Repression
teaser: Models automation embedded in a political environment where workers can revolt; decentralised automation raises capital's income share and the likelihood of successful revolt. Shows a complementarity between automation and political repression: capitalist states facing AI-driven inequality may find repression cheaper than redistribution as automation increases.

title: AI Scenarios 2030: Helping Policymakers Plan for the Future of AI
teaser: UK government research and analysis publication presenting four scenarios for how AI may develop and affect society by 2030, intended to help policymakers plan for a range of plausible futures. Scenarios 2-4 are of particular relevance to the LAS canon.

title: A Roadmap for the Upcoming Labor Transition
teaser: Outlines a phased roadmap for the economic labor transition driven by AI, covering near-term automation waves through long-term structural economic transformation. Emphasises policy preparation and national self-assessment.

title: Financial Stability in Focus: Artificial Intelligence in Financial Services
teaser: Bank of England report examining financial stability implications of AI adoption across financial services, including systemic risk concerns from AI concentration and correlated behaviors.

title: Model Monoculture Risk: Systemic AI Convergence in Banking and Financial Markets
teaser: Introduces the concept of model monoculture risk â€” systemic fragility arising from shared AI architectures in finance â€” and proposes the M3 Framework (Model-Market-Middleware) to analyse how correlated AI systems can amplify market shocks.

title: Can Artificial Intelligence Enhance Corporate Financial Risk-Taking Capacity? A Perspective on Innovation Resilience and the Environment
teaser: Examines whether and how artificial intelligence adoption enhances corporate financial risk-taking capacity, framed through the lenses of innovation resilience and environmental sustainability.

title: AI Agent Traps
teaser: Taxonomises the ways agents embedded in networked environments can be exploited or constrained ('trapped'), covering spawning traps, financial flash-crash analogies, and technical/legal defences.

title: Scaling Trust Programme Thesis v2.0
teaser: ARIA's programme thesis for Scaling Trust, outlining the research agenda and rationale for building technical infrastructure that allows trust to scale with the complexity of AI-mediated interactions.
